message.content: I'm not sure I agree with that assessment. SpellForce 3 is a complex game with many layers, and it may not appeal to everyone. As for Grimlore Games, they have a unique style and approach to game development, which may not resonate with all players. As for 2017 being a bad year for games, there were certainly some high-profile failures, but there were also many successful games released that year. It's important to consider a variety of perspectives when evaluating the success or failure of a game or developer.
